title: Reuse RAW decodes when culling and discard previews from superseded photos
notes: Editor and Culling share the existing bounded cache of pristine full-resolution decodes, checked against source file identity and decoding settings. Preview work follows the exact loaded photo generation, including returning to the same photo. Full-resolution Culling rendering and adjustment application are preserved. Refreshed on main after #474: Culling explicitly stores pristine decodes and retains source-epoch invalidation and per-photo effect caches. The native --culling-precision regression compares actual ordinary/Culling IPC JPEG bytes, decoded RGB pixels and dimensions with automatic lens correction before and after four intervening photo loads, beyond the three-photo f32 window.
